providers.installation: Separately installed Node >=18 package or reviewed source build; Java >=17 for applicable analysis operations; native dependencies may require platform setup.
providers.security: Trusted executable with local filesystem/network/cache access. MineCode uses stdio and a selected capability allowlist; not an OS sandbox.
providers.compatibility: Upstream documents 1.14+ source workflows; individual tool/version/mapping combinations require verification. Legacy 1.8.9/1.12.2 support is not established.

providers.maintenance: Etoryx copy declares relocation; maintained repository last observed push 2026-10-05
providers.installation: Separate Node >=22.16 MCP bridge plus matching Fabric/NeoForge game mod; Node bridge alone cannot observe Minecraft.
providers.security: Loopback bearer-authenticated game bridge. Upstream supports operator-level actions; MineCode defaults expose only game_status/player_state and force MCPFABRIC_AGENT=false.
providers.compatibility: Use a matching upstream version-specific game mod and a connected bridge; check current upstream compatibility before installation.
